# Label Management Requirements Checklist: Candidate-Label Management

**Purpose**: Review the quality of requirements for label management, persistence, recovery, and concurrent administration.
**Created**: 2026-11-14
**Feature**: [Specification](../spec.md) | [Plan](../plan.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by `/speckit-checklist` based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are creation, inspection, renaming, label changes, and removal requirements specified for the complete set lifecycle? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the required fields, minimum label count, and valid empty-collection behavior defined independently? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK003 Are the requirements for making saved sets available to later classification clear without bringing inference into this feature? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006, §Out of Scope]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements for both cancelled and confirmed removal explicit, including the effect on unrelated sets? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements for retaining unsaved content defined for validation, write, and stale-conflict outcomes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, §FR-010, §FR-015]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Are name and label equivalence, surrounding whitespace, case comparison, and preserved display spelling defined consistently? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004, Data Model §Candidate label]
- [ ] CHK007 Are uniqueness boundaries explicit for labels within a set, names across sets, and a set's own renamed identity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the criteria for a valid saved catalog and the treatment of unknown, malformed, or duplicate entries unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-009, Contract §Catalog format]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the meaning of an actionable validation or operational message sufficiently specific for an objective review? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK010 Are session draft ownership, retention duration, and behavior after a refresh or session termination clearly bounded? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Data Model §Session draft]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do the first-use and initialized-missing-file requirements align with the documented inability to distinguish first use from simultaneous loss of the catalog and its initialization evidence? [Conflict, Spec §FR-016, Data Model §Initialization marker]
- [ ] CHK012 Are the requirements for failed writes consistent with the separate indeterminate-outcome contract when a change may already have been committed? [Conflict, Spec §FR-010, Contract §Persistence and conflict contract]
- [ ] CHK013 Are read-only versus blocked operations consistent across the invalid-configuration and recovery descriptions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, Data Model §State and transitions]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the documented label ordering and display-normalization rules compatible with the specification's case-preservation requirement? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, Data Model §Candidate label]
- [ ] CHK015 Are feature scope and dependencies consistent across the specification, plan, and future-classification interface? [Consistency, Spec §Out of Scope, Plan §Summary]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Is the three-minute creation criterion defined with a clear starting point, completion point, and restart expectation? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK017 Are the usability criterion's participant population, minimum sample, first-attempt definition, and calculation sufficiently specified? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Quickstart §User-observable success checks]
- [ ] CHK018 Are the invalid-input and preservation criteria framed so their scenario sets and expected outcomes can be objectively determined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002, §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK019 Are success and failure outcomes independently distinguishable for normal, cancelled, and indeterminate mutations? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-003, Contract §Persistence and conflict contract]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Are first use, a valid empty catalog, initialized missing configuration, and a pre-provisioned catalog specified as distinct situations? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, §FR-016, Data Model §State and transitions]
- [ ] CHK021 Are requirements explicit for a catalog containing both valid and invalid sets, including access and modification restrictions? [Coverage, Spec §FR-009, §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK022 Are concurrent edits and removals addressed when the originally selected set has changed, been removed, or been recreated? [Coverage, Spec §FR-015, Data Model §Candidate-label set]
- [ ] CHK023 Are concurrent creation or renaming conflicts and changes to different sets addressed without losing unrelated updates? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004, §FR-007, Plan §Design and Validation Traceability]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements for failed reads, saves, updates, and removals specified with distinct user-facing outcomes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-010, Contract §Service boundary]
- [ ] CHK025 Are confirmation, cancellation, and stale-confirmation requirements explicit for destructive changes? [Coverage, Spec §FR-008, §FR-015]

## Edge Case and Recovery Coverage

- [ ] CHK026 Are the requirements for missing, corrupt, unreadable, or unwritable initialization evidence defined separately from catalog failures? [Edge Case, Data Model §Initialization marker]
- [ ] CHK027 Are interrupted first initialization and recovery before the first successful catalog save addressed without falsely asserting prior data exists? [Recovery, Research §2]
- [ ] CHK028 Are recovery responsibilities, preservation of surviving data, and conditions for deliberately starting with an empty catalog clearly documented? [Recovery, Spec §FR-014, Quickstart §Recovery]
- [ ] CHK029 Are the expected states after interruption or an uncertain change outcome specified without promising a rollback that may be impossible? [Recovery, Spec §FR-010, Research §4]
- [ ] CHK030 Are stale edits, stale removals, and retained drafts described when a set is removed and recreated under the same name? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-015, Data Model §Candidate-label set]
- [ ] CHK031 Are requirements for a case-only rename, whitespace-only values, and duplicate labels across different sets consistent and complete? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-003, §FR-004, §Assumptions]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK032 Are the trusted-environment boundary and the absence of authentication and authorization stated without treating page visibility as access control? [Security, Spec §FR-013, §Out of Scope]
- [ ] CHK033 Are requirements for safe errors and logs specific about secrets, local paths, and potentially sensitive user-supplied values? [Security, Spec §FR-012, Constitution §8, §10]
- [ ] CHK034 Are keyboard access, accessible names, and error-message accessibility requirements defined for the management workflow or explicitly deferred? [Accessibility, Gap, Spec §User Scenarios & Testing]
- [ ] CHK035 Are supported concurrency and filesystem boundaries, including uncooperative writers and multiple hosts, clearly stated as constraints? [Reliability, Plan §Technical Context, Contract §Persistence and conflict contract]
- [ ] CHK036 Are restart persistence and durability limitations stated consistently without implying guarantees against hardware failure or total evidence loss? [Reliability, Spec §FR-006, §FR-016, Research §4]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK037 Are model availability, model-service credentials, and prediction-storage credentials explicitly excluded as prerequisites for label management? [Dependency, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK038 Are the location, configuration ownership, and version-control expectations for both default and overridden storage locations documented? [Dependency, Plan §Project Structure, Data Model §Catalog]
- [ ] CHK039 Are assumptions about session scope, local trusted administrators, and manual configuration changes visible and aligned with recovery and concurrency requirements? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions, Contract §Persistence and conflict contract]
- [ ] CHK040 Are constraints on collection size, label length, and expected usage scale defined or explicitly acknowledged as unspecified? [Ambiguity, Gap, Plan §Technical Context]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline; items are numbered sequentially for reference.

## Additional Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK041 Are allowed name and label content constraints—including embedded newlines, encoding, and any size limits—specified consistently or explicitly left unrestricted? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §FR-003, §FR-014, Data Model §Candidate label]
- [ ] CHK042 Is the target of an edit or removal unambiguous if the selected set changes after its draft or confirmation is opened? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008, §FR-015, Acceptance Scenarios 5-6, 13]

## Additional Scenario and Recovery Coverage

- [ ] CHK043 Are safe repair steps specified for each blocked configuration state, including invalid or unreadable catalogs, missing catalogs after initialization, and interrupted initialization? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, §FR-010, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK044 Does the first-use warning clearly explain that simultaneous loss of the catalog and initialization evidence cannot be distinguished from genuine first use? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Edge Cases]

## Additional Scope and Configuration Clarity

- [ ] CHK045 Are requirements explicit that label configuration is non-secret, separate from prediction outputs, and does not require or request credentials? [Consistency, Spec §FR-011, §FR-012, Out of Scope, Constitution §6-7]
- [ ] CHK046 Is it clear that administrators may define their own labels without a required example label or default set? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014]
